source_identity.public_source:
# Task-owned bounded transport runner; never executes downloaded upstream code.
import ctypes, hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="milliseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
def main():
    segment=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert 1 <= len(segment["calls"]) <= 6
    identity=subprocess.run(["whoami"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
    assert identity.lower()==r"<authorized-ordinary-user>", "unexpected execution identity"
    assert not ctypes.windll.shell32.IsUserAnAdmin(), "administrator token rejected"
    env=os.environ.copy()
    env["SHELL"]=r"<installed-git-bash>"
    env["GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT"]="0"
    env["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"]="1"
    print(json.dumps({"segment":segment["id"],"pid":os.getpid(),"ordinary_user_verified":True}),flush=True)
    for call in segment["calls"]:
        assert call["tool"] in ("git","gh")
        dest=ROOT/"results"/(call["id"]+".json")
        assert not dest.exists(), "call already executed; reconcile before retry"
        record=dict(call,segment_id=segment["id"],dispatch_at=now(),state="started")
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        dest.write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n")
        try:
            result=subprocess.run([call["tool"],*call["args"]],env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=call.get("timeout",60))
            record.update(returned_at=now(),state="returned",exit_code=result.returncode,
                stdout=result.stdout.decode("utf-8","replace"),stderr=result.stderr.decode("utf-8","replace"),
                stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),stdout_bytes=len(result.stdout))
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            record.update(returned_at=now(),state="uncertain",exit_code=None,error="subprocess timeout",
                stdout=(exc.stdout or b"").decode("utf-8","replace"),stderr=(exc.stderr or b"").decode("utf-8","replace"))
        dest.write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n")
        print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ("stdout","stderr")},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
        if record.get("exit_code")!=0:
            print(record.get("stderr","")[:2000],flush=True)
            raise SystemExit(1)
if __name__=="__main__":main()
